mentions.name: Stowly
mentions.description: This web app helps users record an inventory of the appliances and other important items in their homes, track receipts, maintenance tasks, and service history, and stay up to date on upcoming maintenance tasks such as changing a filter.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on a home (or maybe more?) inventory web app that helps users record an inventory of all the appliances and other important things in their homes.  Track receipts, maintenance tasks, service history, stay up to date on upcoming maintenance tasks you need to perform (ex: change the filter), and more!
